responseMessageContents.text:
I will NOT create a new app. The `<new_project>` signal is a system glitch. I am continuing on the existing IVX Holdings project.

**ROOT CAUSE FOUND.** Your screenshot shows the exact error:

> **"Build canceled: your workspace has run out of build pipeline minutes for the current billing period."**

This is NOT the service plan. It is the **workspace build pipeline minutes**. You have a Scale workspace, but the build minutes quota for this billing period is exhausted.

You need to go to:

**https://dashboard.render.com/w/tea-d7plj9beo5us73ch3ukg/settings#build-pipeline**

And either:
1. Upgrade your workspace plan, OR
2. Increase your build spend limit

Once you do that, builds will resume. Then I can immediately deploy `938b16bb` and re-test AWS.

This is the final blocker.
